text: Q4-Preview Create Task POST https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/img2video [图标] Headers Authorization string * Replace {your api key} with your API key Example: Token {your api key} Body parameters model string * Model name，Accepted values: viduq4-preview viduq4-preview: Supports audio-video synchronization, supports automatic camera switching Allowed values: viduq4-preview images string * An image to be used as the start frame of the generated video. The model will use the image provided via this parameter as the first frame to generate the video. Note 1: Accepts Base64-encoded image or image URL (ensure it is accessible). Note 2: Only 1 image is accepted. Note 3: Supported image formats: png, jpeg, jpg, webp. Note 4: The image size must not exceed 50MB. Note 5: Note that the HTTP body must not exceed 20MB, and the encoding must contain an appropriate content type string. data:image/png;base64,{base64_encode} prompt string A textual description for video generation. Note: Maximum length of 20000 characters. is_rec boolean Whether to use the recommended prompt. true: System will automatically recommend a prompt and use its content to generate the video. false: The video will be generated based on user input prompt. Default: true Allowed values: true false duration integer Video duration. Default: 5 Allowed values: 3 - 16 resolution string Video Resolution. Default: 720p Allowed values: 540p 720p 1080p 2K 4K audio boolean Whether to use direct audio-video generation capability. false: No direct audio-video generation, outputs silent video true: Direct audio-video generation required, outputs video with sound (including dialogue and sound effects) Default: true Allowed values: true false seed integer Random seed Defaults to a random seed number (used when not provided or set to 0) Manually set values will override the default random seed Default: 0 payload string Pass-through parameter Transmitted without processing Note: Maximum length is 1,048,576 characters. callback_url string Callback When creating a task, you need to actively set the callback_url with a POST request. When the video generation task changes its status, Vidu will send a callback request to this URL, containing the latest status of the task. The structure of the callback request content will be the same as the return body of the Get Generation API. The "status" in the callback response includes the following states: processing: Task is being processed. success: Task is completed (if sending fails, it will retry the callback three times). failed: Task failed (if sending fails, it will retry the callback three times). Vidu uses a callback signature algorithm for verification, check out the details here: Callback Signature Response 200 OK application/json Response fields task_id string Task ID generated by Vidu state string Processing state, accepted values: created created successfully queueing task in queue processing processing success generation successful failed task failed model string The model name used for this call prompt string The prompt parameter used for this call images string The image parameter used for this call duration integer The video duration parameter used for this call seed integer The random seed parameter used for this call resolution string The resolution parameter used for this call payload string The transparent transmission parameter passed in this call credits integer The credits consumed by this call created_at string Task creation time Q4-Previerw Query Creations GET https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/tasks/{id}/creations [图标] Headers Authorization string * Replace {your api key} with your API key Example: Token {your api key} Path parameters id string * Task ID, returned by the Create Task API upon successful creation Response 200 OK application/json Response fields Expand all id string Task ID state string Processing state, accepted values: created created successfully queueing task in queue processing processing success generation successful failed task failed err_code string Error code, see the error code table for details credits integer The number of credits consumed by this task (unit: credits) payload string The payload (pass-through) parameter passed in for this task call [图标] creations array Generation results id string Generation ID, used to identify different creations url string Creation URL, valid for 24 hours cover_url string Creation cover, valid for 24 hours watermarked_url string Watermarked creation URL, valid for 24 hours
